hero.title:
Technology that
keeps business moving.
hero.lead: We connect data, systems and AI to the way your team works — from trading and marketing to the systems that run the business.
hero.note:
Software for trading,
AI marketing and business.
hero.flowCaption: One system, extended in many directions

pillars.title: Trading technology
pillars.body: Market data, orders and trading systems

pillars.title: Digital experience
pillars.body: Websites and pages ready for real use

services.label: 02 / SERVICES
services.title:
Systems built as parts
that connect into one picture
services.lead: Before work starts we describe what we will build, its scope and its connections, so each system fits today and leaves room to grow.
services.note: Start with one system or plan an ecosystem where data flows on — scope is set by how the business actually works.

items.name: PG Broker API
items.body: Connects market data and order flow

items.name: PG Ads AI
items.body: Manages ad budgets and creative with AI

items.name: PG AI
items.body: AI models and workflows for organisations

capability.label: 03 / FEATURED CAPABILITY
capability.title:
Start from a core capability,
then connect the work around it
capability.lead: PG Broker API and PG Ads AI show how we turn data into work. PG AI and the business systems carry the workflow through to where the team actually uses it.

broker.name: PG Broker API
broker.body: Connects market data and order flow
broker.detail: We define sources, data structure, order logic and the states to track, so the team can see what each connection point does.

ads.name: PG Ads AI
ads.body: Manages ad budgets and creative with AI
ads.detail: We set rules for budget, audience, creative and review so AI helps where it fits — and the team still sees the reasoning and stays in control.

principles.label: 04 / PRINCIPLES
principles.title:
Think in systems,
talk like people

items.name: Clarity
items.sub: Clear from brief to daily use
items.body: Scope, logic and next action are visible to every team.

items.name: Craft
items.sub: Care for the system and the experience
items.body: Technical detail and the way people use it move together.

items.name: Momentum
items.body: No dead ends — the system is ready for change.

process.label: 05 / WORKING PROCESS
process.title:
Start from clear requirements,
build so the team sees progress
process.lead: We split decisions into steps, so scope is agreed early, connections are tested quickly and the system improves from real use.

steps.name: Brief
steps.body: Understand goals, users, data and existing constraints

steps.name: Scope
steps.body: Separate what to build, the connection points and how teams work together

steps.name: Build in stages
steps.body: Core first, then detail, reviewed together

steps.name: Connect
steps.body: Test data, states and workflow across related systems

steps.name: Improve from use
steps.body: Learn from real work, then plan the next round

process.summary: Explain what we will build before explaining how it changes the business

ecosystem.label: 06 / CONNECTED ECOSYSTEM
ecosystem.title:
One set of data runs through the workflow
and returns as a decision
ecosystem.lead: Good architecture doesn't put everything in one system. It decides what is the source, where the logic lives and who needs to see the result.
ecosystem.mapNote: Where the system decides or hands work on

useCases.label: 07 / USE CASES
useCases.title:
Results explained by how the work is done,
not vague promises
useCases.lead: Each use case starts from the real work: who uses which data, when they decide, and where the system should remove friction.

items.name: Trading with clear status
items.body: Market data, orders and the states to track live in one flow.

items.name: Marketing where AI works within limits
items.body: Budget, creative, audience and review — the team still controls the reasoning.

items.name: Sales works from the same data
items.body: Customers and activity from every channel enter one clear follow-up process.

items.name: Front office and back office, joined
items.body: Website, store, stock, payments and support keep the data moving.

contact.label: 08 / START A CONVERSATION
contact.title:
Start with your problem,
then shape the right system.
contact.lead: Tell us how your team works today, where the data lives and where a system should help. We start by understanding the requirements and what scope is realistic.
